notes: Recreation Commission minutes, February 1941 - December 1943. Curated: William G. Merchant's commissions (Corona Heights, Stern Grove, Sunset, Grattan, St. Mary's, Potrero Hill), the Estes and Sweeney sundials, Stern Grove bowling greens, Gilman and Silver Terrace land.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: Longfellow Playground (Lowell and Morse Streets) field house drawings, Dec 1941 (no page); the American Legion marker for the first public playground at Bush and Hyde Streets, Oct 1941 (no page); Father Crowley Playground (no page); the Camp Mather recreation building (outside the city); the Crystal Palace Plunge lease talks; the Bay View Playground purchase (site not tied to a present park); a 1941 proposal to level Bernal Mountain for a playfield (final approval withheld); Upper Noe Valley playground purchase request, Jan 1943 (request only).
coverage.note: Dated by the opener 'called to order this day, <Month d>' (year from the volume order); every date checked against its Thursday. Curated list RC1941.py.

findings.description: The Recreation Commission declined the West Portal P.T.A.'s request to rename the playground the Charlotte Estes Playground, keeping its policy against renaming established playgrounds, and suggested an inscribed sundial or drinking fountain in her memory instead.
